name: Water Breathing: First Form
description: A flowing sword style built on long exhales and fluid footwork, with each cutting form flowing directly into the next.

steps.instruction: Stand in a low, bladed stance with one foot forward.
Hold both hands together as if gripping a sword low at your side.
Take a slow, controlled breath in.
Step forward while exhaling and sweeping the arms in an arc.
Finish with the arms extended, following the arc's direction.
